reason: $24.99 for the first box is about 83 cents a day and I can get my money back if I finish it, so a one-box trial is low risk. I'd only buy during the launch price, not at $29.99.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? I'm not sure bisglycinate alone does enough for gym recovery.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price ended or the box went back to $29.99 with no deal, I'd skip it and keep buying the multi-form stuff on sale.
